leaves.leaf: Two one-card CUDA streams and a matching event wait
leaves.replaces: TP2PP2 PrefillPPChannel send/receive on separate devices with NCCL
leaves.basis: Actual CUDA Event.record, Stream.wait_event and Event.query run on one 3090. No NCCL collective or independent device/worker is constructed. The typed PP stop obligation is proven separately by connected CPU processes.

leaves.leaf: Two serialized peer QSA programs on one GPU
leaves.replaces: Two TP workers with separate private streams and arenas
leaves.basis: The native18 skew probe executes real QSA selection/copy/attention kernels and host-queried events in both skew directions. It serializes arena ownership because the one-card venue cannot reproduce TP NCCL progress.

leaves.leaf: Tie-heavy discrete bf16 Q/K values and a synthetic 50-page cache
leaves.replaces: Checkpoint-weighted QSA indexer scores and actual scheduler page map
leaves.basis: The pinned indexer scoring, persistent top-k, expansion and native union kernels execute at 64 query rows against the 202400-token history geometry. Synthetic low-cardinality Q/K deliberately stresses tie-breaking; it does not establish model logits or real per-rank score equality.

leaves.leaf: A separate CUDA stream running a bounded sleep kernel
leaves.replaces: Concurrent decode/model load while QSA selection runs
leaves.basis: The load perturbs stream scheduling without constructing another model, engine or GPU owner. Idle and loaded selected-set digests are compared over 200 repeats each.
